_note: The hotel-group strip (src/components/HotelGroups.astro): plain-text group names, NO logos, each linked to our published case studies at that group's hotels. A group appears only if it has a published case study, and only where the repo itself ties the hotel to the group (the 'source' of each entry). Rosewood is left out: the published Rosewood London job was for Calico Wallpaper and Ahluwalia, with Rosewood as the venue, not the client.
